It took three months but the first version of my #Java property-based testing library is finally published! https://github.com/josephjunker/presume

Reasons why you might like this:

- MIT licensed, no unusual limitations
- 98% human authored
- Supports both direct and functional styles, which makes it easier to define complex and recursive generator types

Reasons you might not like this:
- Around 1-2% LLM authored (I ran out of steam while fighting with Gradle configuration and fixing/testing bit-twiddling logic in 3 methods)
- Still very new and not remotely at feature parity with more mature solutions
- In dire need of more documentation, which I hope to write in the next couple of weeks.
- Uses what I believe to be a novel shrinking algorithm, which appears to work well but which is not as battle-tested as the Hypothesis approach.

Really interested to hear people's feedback on the code and API!

#FunctionalProgramming #programming
